title: Complete Nonderogatory to Cyclic Vector: The General Case (All Fields)

problemStatement.formal: theorem nonderogatory_has_cyclic_vector_any_field {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (h : IsNonderogatory M) : ∃ v, IsCyclicVector M v
problemStatement.plain: If M is nonderogatory (minpoly = charpoly) over ANY field K (including finite fields with |K| <= n), then M has a cyclic vector v such that {v, Mv, ..., M^{n-1}v} is a basis. This is the field-independent version completing the Cayley-Hamilton minpoly research cluster.
whyMatters: Removes the [Infinite K] hypothesis from OQ-05-OQ-01 -- the theorem holds universally
Resolves the last sorry in CayleyHamiltonMinpolyOQ05OQ01OQ04.lean
Completes the nonderogatory/cyclic-vector thread in the Cayley-Hamilton gallery cluster
Requires a proof route that avoids the full PID structure theorem (not in Mathlib)
Forces exploration of companion matrix similarity or direct span arguments in Lean 4

cyclic_vector_of_similar: if M ~ M' and v is cyclic for M', then there is a cyclic vector for M
